━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

  Unity
    • Import FBX files via Assets > Import New Asset
    • Skeleton: Humanoid rig
    • Recommended: Use the Animator Controller with the included clips

  Unreal Engine / FAB
    • Import FBX with "Import Animations" enabled
    • Skeleton: UE4 Mannequin-compatible humanoid
    • Use a Retarget Asset if your skeleton differs

  Frame rate: 30 FPS
  Up axis: Y-Up (standard humanoid)
